LanguageData.YASTM.Storyteller.April.Tagline: “We proceed by the book — but keep our hearts open.”
LanguageData.YASTM.Storyteller.April.Fluff1: Admiral April favors exploration beats, rescue opportunities, and honest trade. Expect pressure to rise with your capabilities.
LanguageData.YASTM.Storyteller.April.Fluff2: Red and Yellow Alert systems pair well with April’s cadence: prepare in the quiet, act with discipline when crisis strikes.
